package.name: oa_mit
package.description: Bilateral force-feedback teleop built on the openarmx MIT layer. The bilateral node is derived from openarmx_teleop_bimanual (teleop_bimanual_with_gravitycomp_single, CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0): a weightless gravity-compensated leader (MIT kp=0, torque=gravity) plus a force- reflection coupling from the follower's joint states (couple_kp).
